name: Quanta Computer Inc.
summary: Quanta Computer Inc. manufactures, processes, and sells laptop computers and cloud-computing server related products in the United States, Mainland China, the Netherlands, Japan, and internationally. The company provides notebook PCs; servers, storage devices, and network switches; cameras, including automotive cameras, camera module, and AI dash-camera and AI body-worn camera; and smart healthcare solutions.
